completion:
Photocopy the failing test pages.
3. Cross reference it with your work log, noting the plug tester job number, appliance tag number, and appliance maker and model.
4. Then enter this data on a separate hand-written data record. The handwritten data should include:
   - Job number
   - Name of owner
   - Address of owner
   - Date of test
   - Location of appliance tested
   - Name, address, city, contact phone, and phone of manufacturer
   - Part number of appliance
   - Name of failing parts
   - Name of adapter
   - Name of passer
   - Schematic in the shape
5. Attach the photocopies to the back of the hand written data sheet.
6. Place photocopies in a numbered notebook.
